reason: Integrates DeepSeek Harness with Telegram for phone-based task submission, session routing, notifications, agent questions, and approval handling.

summaries.zh: 通过 Telegram Bot 将 DeepSeek Harness 的任务、结果、通知、提问和审批交互连接到手机端。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a Telegram bot for phone-based task submission, session routing, notifications, agent questions, and approval handling.

capabilities: Connects to the Telegram Bot API using configured credentials
Receives Telegram messages and routes them to DeepSeek Harness sessions
Sends task results, agent questions, notifications, and approval requests to Telegram
Accepts approval or rejection responses from Telegram and forwards them to sessions
Persists Telegram update cursors and duty-mode state locally
